evidence.access: Retrieval trimmed per document — access follows the source (groups), injection-proof.
evidence.evaluated: Every answer cites its source or declines; deterministic gate + groundedness judges.
evidence.empty: The sources the answer cites show up here — every claim grounded in the knowledge base, not in guesswork.

login.note: Answers cite their source and respect each document's access. That is why we need to know who is asking.

overview.title: Overview
overview.tagline: An assurance mechanism on top of Microsoft Foundry.
overview.lede: Point it at a repository or knowledge base and get three guarantees: the KB is built faithfully, the agent answers with grounded citations, and access is secure per document. The domain is swappable — here are four.
overview.g1Body: The knowledge base is generated from real code and locked by a gate: ≥80% of citations must resolve to a file that exists.
overview.g2Body: Retrieval is trimmed per document by the source's own read groups — no classification in code, injection-proof.
overview.g3Body: Every answer cites its source or declines. Deterministic gate in CI + Foundry groundedness judges, wired to the traces.

tickets.subtitleLong: Real tickets opened by the concierge — the create_ticket tool runs only after you approve the escalation in the chat.

knowledge.title: Knowledge bases
knowledge.subtitle: Your project's bases and the sources feeding them — read straight from the service, without opening the portal.
knowledge.orphanBody: Each source keeps an indexer running. A source no base references costs money without answering anything — delete it or attach it to a base.
knowledge.emptyBody: A knowledge base is what gives the agent something to cite. Create the first one by pointing at files or a repository.
